messages:
Lena Ortiz: Quick note from a call with BeaconAI 1: they want a predictable low-latency offering for inference-heavy features. Question: new tier vs add-on?
Rishi Kapoor: Add-on preferred. Easier rollout and toggling per-route.
Tara Nguyen: Tech constraints: we should limit to specific models and <=128 tokens for GA. Also need router label and dedicated telemetry.
Jon Park: Finance: need floor price ensuring >=50% gross margin at expected utilization. Pilot promo floor 40% with 6mo commitment + case study.
Lena Ortiz: Proposed launch gates: perf validated (p50 <=70ms for 128 tokens), billing pipeline shows invoice preview, Console toggle + explanatory copy, SLA/legal draft ready.
Tara Nguyen: Ops: require emergency ops override (30min expiry), circuit-breaker on burst >2x commit, and fallback to standard tier when capacity exhausted.
legal_bot: Draft contract clauses created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/LEGAL-314. Includes burst billing, early termination fee, and case study opt-in.
Rishi Kapoor: Rollout plan: pilot (3 customers) -> beta (20) -> GA. Measure ARR uplift and churn signal at each stage.
Jon Park: I'll prepare pricing bands and promo approval path in Stripe.
Lena Ortiz: Action items captured in PRD: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRD-900. Meeting Friday to finalize customer list. Add anything missing. :thumbsup:
